programs.name: Computing Science
programs.description: CS program at Nijmegen with strong research orientation. Algorithms, AI, and data science. Radboud has Netherlands' leading AI research group and Donders Institute for Brain research.

programs.name: Medicine
programs.description: Six-year medical program in Dutch. Radboud's medical faculty (Radboudumc) is internationally recognized for research. Numerus fixus highly competitive.
entryRequirements: VWO with Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics

programs.name: Artificial Intelligence
programs.description: Dedicated AI program with cognitive computing, machine learning, and robotics. Strong ties to Donders Institute for Brain, Cognition and Behaviour — one of Europe's leading neuroscience research centers.

programs.name: Molecular Life Sciences
programs.description: Biochemistry, molecular biology, and biomedical research. Radboudumc provides excellent research opportunities. Focus on cancer research, neuroscience, and stem cell biology.

programs.name: Psychology
programs.description: Specializations in clinical psychology, cognitive neuroscience, and social psychology. Radboud has Netherlands' leading Donders Institute providing research and clinical training.

programs.name: International Economics
programs.description: International trade, economic development, and emerging markets. Research-focused with opportunities for policy work at EU institutions.
